renderings.value: What in the world do the Japanese know about living? From the moment they enter elementary school, they try their hardest to power through the days. They think life begins after that. Once they're out of school and get a job, they work to get it done. They think life begins after that. But life doesn't begin after that.
The present is the line drawn between past and future. If there is not life on this line, then there is no life anywhere.
